kept include/vulkan/*.h, include/vk_video/*.h, LICENSE.md, LICENSES/MIT.txt (dual Apache-2.0 OR MIT, used under MIT; C++ headers and the registry left out)
why the Vulkan API declarations for the Vulkan RHI backend (rhi/vulkan). The loader comes with the GPU driver (vulkan-1.dll), so no Vulkan SDK is needed to build or run.
